instructions: ALWAYS use fully qualified table names: `project.dataset.table`.

For patents.publications: title and abstract are ARRAYS. ALWAYS use `title_localized[SAFE_OFFSET(0)].text` and `abstract_localized[SAFE_OFFSET(0)].text` for selecting or filtering — NEVER use `title` or `abstract` directly.
To search patent titles/abstracts for a compound, use LOWER() with REGEXP_CONTAINS on the localized text fields.
To search drug labels for active ingredients, use REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(active_ingredient), LOWER('drug_name')).
To link drug_label to ChEMBL molecules conceptually: search by matching LOWER(openfda_generic_name) or LOWER(active_ingredient) to LOWER(molecule_dictionary.pref_name).
To get PhysioChem data, always JOIN molecule_dictionary to compound_properties on molregno.
For FTO queries, focus on patents with country_code IN ('US', 'EP', 'WO') and grant_date > 0.
Always LIMIT results to 100 rows maximum.
Return ONLY valid BigQuery Standard SQL with no markdown fences, no explanation, just the raw SQL.
